title: Define the colored maze
description: You build the wall grid and assign deterministic labels to free cells.

steps.description: You define Maze with grid and colors arrays. The five-row grid uses zero for free cells and one for walls.
You initialize color values to zero and assign (i + 2*j + c) % 4 at free cells. c remains zero throughout these loops.

steps.question: Does N count only free cells or every grid position?
steps.answer: N is H*W, so it counts every position, including walls. Here 5*7 gives 35 states.

steps.description: You construct the maze and derive its dimensions and color count. The recording reports a 5 by 7 maze, 35 states, and four colors.
